name: Turn an incident into a safer procedure
why: A blameless incident report, a safer procedure draft and tracked prevention actions, matching steps 6 and 7 of the incident skill.

name: Prepare a supplier corrective action review
why: Checks a supplier's corrective action reply against inspection evidence, for the external provider part of an ISO 9001 system.

name: Supplier correction evidence review assistant
why: Tracks supplier corrective action evidence against your acceptance standard over time.

name: Pre-shipment inspection brief writer
why: An inspector's checklist and pass or reject rule for goods from a factory, a quality control for bought-in products.

name: Build a volunteer induction checklist
why: An induction procedure with sign-offs and supervised practice, a close cousin of the safety induction prompt.

name: Recall quiz writer
why: Turns talk notes into a short recall quiz, useful for the quick check after each toolbox talk.

name: Prepare a service outage communication pack
why: First notice, updates and all-clear messages for an outage, for the message pack in a continuity plan.

name: Plan staff coverage during a disruption
why: Coverage options, escalation roles and messages when staff can't get to work, a continuity scenario.

name: Prepare a vendor security questionnaire response
why: Evidence-based questionnaire answers with an evidence index, the same method as the QHSE questionnaire prompt.

name: Decision checklist builder
why: Builds a short checklist for a decision you keep making, handy for reportability and stop-work decision aids.
